name: nse-option-chain-app
description: NSE Option Chain Viewer — Node.js backend + React frontend + Electron Windows app

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build:exe: npm run build:client && electron-builder --config electron/build.config.js --win nsis
scripts.build:msi: npm run build:client && electron-builder --config electron/build.config.js --win msi
scripts.build:zip: npm run build:client && electron-builder --config electron/build.config.js --win zip
